invariants.text: A task with a null due_date must have a status that is not 'completed'.
A task's priority must be one of 'low', 'medium', 'high', or 'urgent'.
A task's status must be one of 'pending', 'in-progress', 'completed', or 'cancelled'.
If a task's due_date is set, it must be a valid date in the past or in the future, and cannot be null.
If a task's status is 'completed', its due_date must be in the past or equal to the current date.
Task.task_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The total number of tasks with status 'completed' must not exceed 30% of the total number of tasks in the database.
When a task is updated, its due_date must not be set to a future date if its status is 'completed'.
When exporting tasks to JSON, all tasks must include their task_id, title, description, due_date, status, and priority fields.
When importing tasks from JSON, each task must have a non-empty title and a valid due_date if provided.
When importing tasks from JSON, if a task has a due_date, it must be a valid ISO-formatted date string or a valid datetime object.
